image_query: Mathura Buddha red sandstone Kushan sculpture
tweets: The Mathura School, 1st–2nd century CE: among India's earliest Buddha images, carved in warm red sandstone flecked with cream. The robe bares the right shoulder; the hand lifts in abhaya mudrā — fearlessness — a visual language born on the Yamunā, not borrowed.
